name: Life spaceship 0af25862 on 3-uniform tiling k3-055
description: A period-32 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-055, with touching neighbours, 28 to 66 cells, moving eight lattice steps every 32 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 8,192 rules from B3/S23 to B3,11,12/S2,3,10,11,12. JETCARP's Life census met it in one of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
